event_summary: A white folded card on a black circular base turns while a blue-and-black holder carrying an orange ball moves downward and becomes partly or fully hidden by the card.
raw_event_description: At the start, a white A-shaped folded card stands on a black circular base on a tabletop, with an orange ball held in a blue-and-black U-shaped holder above it. The folded card changes orientation around a vertical axis, showing first an angled A-frame view, then a broad front face, then another angled view. During the same interval, the holder and orange ball move downward along the central vertical area. The front white panel passes in front of the ball and holder, hiding them for several frames. Later the orange ball and blue parts of the holder are briefly visible lower and partly behind the folded card, then the card continues turning and the ball becomes mostly hidden again.

reasons: The folded white card, black base, orange ball, and blue-and-black holder are all visible.
The objects are already arranged for the visible motion, with the ball above the folded card.

evidence_bank.observation: The folded white card is standing on the black circular base.
The orange ball is visible between the blue-and-black curved holder arms.
The orange ball is located above the top fold of the white card.
A black cord lies on the tabletop to the right of the circular base.
The white folded card shows a narrow A-frame view.
The blue-and-black holder and orange ball move lower in the frame.
The front white panel turns to present a broad rectangular face toward the camera.
The orange ball is hidden behind the broad white panel.
The vertical rod is visible above the white panel.
Blue parts of the holder reappear partly at the left and right sides behind the folded card.
The orange ball reappears low and partly visible through the opening between the card panels.
The folded card returns to an angled A-frame view while continuing to change orientation.

observations: The main objects are visible with the ball held above the folded card.
The card begins or continues changing orientation.

object_events.observation: The folded card changes from an angled A-frame view toward a different orientation.
The orange ball moves downward with the holder.
The holder moves downward with the orange ball between its arms.

observations: The white card presents a broad front face.
The ball and holder are mostly or fully blocked from view by the card.

object_events.observation: The front panel faces the camera more directly and covers the central area.
The orange ball becomes hidden from view.
The vertical rod remains visible above the card.

observations: The folded card continues turning past the broad front view.
Parts of the holder and the orange ball become briefly visible lower behind or within the opening of the folded card.

object_events.observation: The folded card changes back toward an angled A-frame view.
The orange ball is briefly visible low between the card panels and then becomes mostly hidden again.
Blue side portions of the holder are partly visible behind the folded card.

unresolved_observations: The black circular base is round and dark, so any rotation of the base itself is not visually separable from the changing orientation of the folded card.
The ball and holder are hidden by the white card for part of the event, so their exact positions during that interval are not visible.
